.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (all 38 criterion ids; full text of lines 94-125)

Sibling comparison: projects/patchpad-editor/instruction.md, projects/patchpad-editor-v3/instruction.md, task.toml and judge.toml criterion ids; projects/gridforge-spreadsheet-v3 and projects/boardloom-infinite-canvas instruction.md and task.toml; directory listing of projects/
evidence: Authored for this product: instruction.md:1 gives a product-specific motive ('paste a long one-line experiment, format it, make changes in several places, and then run it beside the source'); task.toml:5-6,15 name/description/arena_slice ('custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history') describe a code playground; tests/app_context.md:6,10,14 describe the same app with no accounts. All template CHANGE_ME identity fields are replaced. A case-insensitive grep of the frozen task for patchpad|incident|gridforge|boardloom|hireops|bazaar|northwind|threadline|workbook|spreadsheet returned no file, so there is no sibling residue. Closest sibling is PatchPad (projects/patchpad-editor*, an incident-report text editor with custom surface, multi-caret, find/replace, revisions and stale-save refusal). Colderwater shares that editor core and the banned-widget list (ui.md:3 versus patchpad-editor/instruction.md 'Custom editor surface'), and about 14 of its 38 functional criteria cover the same concepts (for example cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic at functional/judge.toml:96 versus multi_caret_full_typing_single_undo at patchpad-editor-v3/tests/functional/judge.toml:249), but the criterion text is written afresh with different fixtures, not renamed. The remaining roughly 24 functional criteria have no PatchPad counterpart: semantic colouring (judge.toml:168,177), Format document (186,195,204), isolated preview and run lifecycle (213-294: error line numbers, promise rejection, last-good recovery, five-second budget, Stop, superseded runs, isolation, dynamic-code refusal), live library refresh (339,348,357), same-line carets (114), undo caret restore (123), self-containing replacement (159). Data shape also differs: empty seed and a multi-record shared snippet library (seed_data.json; integration.md) against PatchPad's single seeded document. No other sibling under projects/ is a playground or devtools product (grep for playground|snippet matched only this task plus an unrelated docketlight task.toml hit). So this is not the defect described in quality-checks.md:214 ('same flows, same criteria, renamed entities'). Caveat, not a measurement gap for this row: the frozen rules contain no written suite domain plan document, so 'fits the suite's domain plan' was judged the way quality-checks.md:213 prescribes, by comparing sibling task names and concepts; category 'programming' with a devtools slug is the only such product in projects/. task.toml:14 provenance 'Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task' is terse but truthful and is not a clone signal. No runtime evidence is required for this row.
